hadiths.arabicText: وَحَدَّثَنِي ، عَنْ /12 مَالِك /12 ، عَنْ /94 زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ L3122 /94 ، عَنْ /26 عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعْدِ بْنِ مُعَاذٍ L6203 /26 ، عَنْ /93 جَدَّتِهِ L2577 /93 ، /27 أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ : " يَا نِسَاءَ الْمُؤْمِنَاتِ /20 لَا تَحْقِرَنَّ إِحْدَاكُنَّ لِجَارَتِهَا وَلَوْ كُرَاعَ شَاةٍ مُحْرَقًا " /27
hadiths.english_translation: Narrated from his grandmother: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'O women of the believers, let not any one of you despise (a gift to give) to her neighbor, even if it be a scorched sheep's trotter.'

hadiths.arabicText: وَحَدَّثَنِي ، عَنْ /12 مَالِك /12 ، عَنْ /94 عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ L4632 /94 ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ : /27 قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : /20 " قَاتَلَ اللَّهُ الْيَهُودَ نُهُوا عَنْ أَكْلِ الشَّحْمِ فَبَاعُوهُ فَأَكَلُوا ثَمَنَهُ " /27 . وَحَدَّثَنِي ، عَنْ /12 مَالِك /12 أَنَّهُ بَلَغَهُ ، أَنَّ /56 عِيسَى ابْنَ مَرْيَمَ /56 ، كَانَ يَقُولُ : " يَا بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ عَلَيْكُمْ بِالْمَاءِ الْقَرَاحِ وَالْبَقْلِ الْبَرِّيِّ وَخُبْزِ الشَّعِيرِ ، وَإِيَّاكُمْ وَخُبْزَ الْبُرِّ ، فَإِنَّكُمْ لَنْ تَقُومُوا بِشُكْرِهِ "
hadiths.english_translation: Abdullah ibn Abi Bakr said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'May Allah curse the Jews. They were forbidden to eat fat, so they sold it and ate its price.' And it reached Malik that Isa ibn Maryam used to say: 'O Children of Israel, you must have pure water, wild herbs, and barley bread, and beware of wheat bread, for you will not be able to fulfill its gratitude.'

hadiths.arabicText: وَحَدَّثَنِي ، عَنْ /12 مَالِك /12 أَنَّهُ بَلَغَهُ ، /27 أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ " دَخَلَ الْمَسْجِدَ فَوَجَدَ فِيهِ أَبَا بَكْرٍ الصِّدِّيقَ ، وَعُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ فَسَأَلَهُمَا ، فَقَالَا : أَخْرَجَنَا الْجُوعُ ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " وَأَنَا أَخْرَجَنِي الْجُوعُ " ، فَذَهَبُوا إِلَى أَبِي الْهَيْثَمِ بْنِ التَّيِّهَانِ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ ، فَأَمَرَ لَهُمْ بِشَعِيرٍ عِنْدَهُ يُعْمَلُ وَقَامَ يَذْبَحُ لَهُمْ شَاةً ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " نَكِّبْ عَنْ ذَاتِ الدَّرِّ " ، فَذَبَحَ لَهُمْ شَاةً وَاسْتَعْذَبَ لَهُمْ مَاءً ، فَعُلِّقَ فِي نَخْلَةٍ ، ثُمَّ أُتُوا بِذَلِكَ الطَّعَامِ ، فَأَكَلُوا مِنْهُ وَشَرِبُوا مِنْ ذَلِكَ الْمَاءِ ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : /20 " لَتُسْأَلُنَّ عَنْ نَعِيمِ هَذَا الْيَوْمِ "
hadiths.english_translation: It reached Malik that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ entered the mosque and found in it Abu Bakr al-Siddiq and Umar ibn al-Khattab, and he asked them (what brought them out), so they said: 'Hunger drove us out.' So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'And hunger drove me out too.' So they went to Abu al-Haytham ibn al-Tayyihan al-Ansari, and he ordered barley that he had to be prepared, and he stood up to slaughter a sheep for them. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Avoid the one that gives milk.' So he slaughtered a sheep for them and fetched sweet water for them, which was hung on a date palm. Then that food was brought to them, and they ate from it and drank from that water. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'You will surely be asked about the blessings of this day.'

hadiths.arabicText: وَحَدَّثَنِي ، عَنْ /12 مَالِك /12 ، عَنْ /94 يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ L8272 /94 ، /27 أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ كَانَ يَأْكُلُ خُبْزًا بِسَمْنٍ ، فَدَعَا رَجُلًا مِنْ أَهْلِ الْبَادِيَةِ فَجَعَلَ يَأْكُلُ وَيَتَّبِعُ بِاللُّقْمَةِ وَضَرَ الصَّحْفَةِ ، فَقَالَ /93 عُمَرُ L5913 /93 : " كَأَنَّكَ مُقْفِرٌ ؟ " فَقَالَ : وَاللَّهِ مَا أَكَلْتُ سَمْنًا وَلَا لُكْتُ أَكْلًا بِهِ مُنْذُ كَذَا وَكَذَا ، فَقَالَ عُمَرُ : /20 " لَا آكُلُ السَّمْنَ حَتَّى يَحْيَا النَّاسُ مِنْ أَوَّلِ مَا يَحْيَوْنَ " /27 * وَحَدَّثَنِي ، عَنْ /12 مَالِك /12 ، عَنْ /94 إِسْحَاق بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ L952 /94 ، عَنْ /93 أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ L720 /93 ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ : /27 رَأَيْتُ /93 عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ L5913 /93 وَهُوَ يَوْمَئِذٍ أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ ، /20 " يُطْرَحُ لَهُ صَاعٌ مِنْ تَمْرٍ فَيَأْكُلُهُ حَتَّى يَأْكُلَ حَشَفَهَا "
hadiths.english_translation: Yahya ibn Sa'id reported that Umar ibn al-Khattab was eating bread with ghee, and he invited a man from the desert people. He (the man) began to eat and follow the bottom of the bowl with the morsel. Umar said: 'It seems you are very hungry?' He said: 'By Allah, I have not eaten ghee nor had food mixed with it for such and such time.' So Umar said: 'I will not eat ghee until the people revive from the first things by which they revive.' And Ishaq ibn Abdullah ibn Abi Talhah narrated from Anas ibn Malik that he said: I saw Umar ibn al-Khattab, and he was at that time Amir al-Mu'minin (Commander of the Believers), a sa' of dates would be brought to him and he would eat it until he ate its inferior dates (hashaf).

hadiths.arabicText: وَحَدَّثَنِي ، عَنْ /12 مَالِك /12 ، عَنْ /94 عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ L4797 /94 ، عَنْ /93 عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ L4967 /93 ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ : /27 سُئِلَ /93 عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ L5913 /93 عَنِ الْجَرَادِ ، فَقَالَ : /20 " وَدِدْتُ أَنَّ عِنْدِي قَفْعَةً نَأْكُلُ مِنْهُ "

hadiths.arabicText: وَحَدَّثَنِي ، عَنْ /12 مَالِك /12 ، عَنْ /94 مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ حَلْحَلَةَ L7221 /94 ، عَنْ /26 حُمَيْدِ بْنِ مَالِكِ بْنِ خُثَيْمٍ L2548 /26 ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ : /27 كُنْتُ جَالِسًا مَعَ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ بِأَرْضِهِ /60 بِالْعَقِيقِ /60 ، فَأَتَاهُ قَوْمٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ /60 الْمَدِينَةِ /60 عَلَى دَوَابٍّ فَنَزَلُوا عِنْدَهُ ، قَالَ حُمَيْدٌ : فَقَالَ /93 أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ L4396 /93 : " اذْهَبْ إِلَى أُمِّي ، فَقُلْ : إِنَّ ابْنَكِ يُقْرِئُكِ السَّلَامَ ، وَيَقُولُ : أَطْعِمِينَا شَيْئًا " ، قَالَ : فَوَضَعَتْ ثَلَاثَةَ أَقْرَاصٍ فِي صَحْفَةٍ وَشَيْئًا مِنْ زَيْتٍ وَمِلْحٍ ، ثُمَّ وَضَعَتْهَا عَلَى رَأْسِي وَحَمَلْتُهَا إِلَيْهِمْ ، فَلَمَّا وَضَعْتُهَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ كَبَّرَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ ، وَقَالَ : " الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَشْبَعَنَا مِنَ الْخُبْزِ بَعْدَ أَنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ طَعَامُنَا إِلَّا الْأَسْوَدَيْنِ الْمَاءَ وَالتَّمْرَ " ، فَلَمْ يُصِبْ الْقَوْمُ مِنَ الطَّعَامِ شَيْئًا ، فَلَمَّا انْصَرَفُوا ، قَالَ : يَا ابْنَ أَخِي /20 " أَحْسِنْ إِلَى غَنَمِكَ وَامْسَحْ الرُّعَامَ عَنْهَا ، وَأَطِبْ مُرَاحَهَا وَصَلِّ فِي نَاحِيَتِهَا ، فَإِنَّهَا مِنْ دَوَابِّ الْجَنَّةِ ، وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ لَيُوشِكُ أَنْ يَأْتِيَ عَلَى النَّاسِ زَمَانٌ تَكُونُ الثُّلَّةُ مِنَ الْغَنَمِ أَحَبَّ إِلَى صَاحِبِهَا مِنْ دَارِ مَرْوَانَ "
hadiths.english_translation: Humayd ibn Malik ibn Khuthaym said: I was sitting with Abu Hurairah in his land in al-Aqiq, and some people from the people of Madinah came to him on riding animals and they dismounted near him. Humayd said: Abu Hurairah said (to me): 'Go to my mother and say: Your son sends you greetings and says: Feed us something.' He said: So she placed three loaves in a bowl with some oil and salt, then placed it on my head, and I carried it to them. When I placed it before them, Abu Hurairah said takbir and said: 'Praise be to Allah who has satisfied us with bread after our food was only the two black things: water and dates.' But the people did not have any of the food. When they left, he said: 'O nephew, be good to your sheep, wipe the mucus from them, make their resting place good, and pray in their vicinity, for they are among the animals of Paradise. By the One in Whose hand is my soul, there will soon come upon people a time when a flock of sheep will be more beloved to its owner than the House of Marwan.'

hadiths.arabicText: وَحَدَّثَنِي ، عَنْ /12 مَالِك /12 ، عَنْ /94 أَبِي نُعَيْمٍ وَهْبِ بْنِ كَيْسَانَ L8181 /94 ، قَالَ : /27 أُتِيَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بِطَعَامٍ وَمَعَهُ /64 رَبِيبُهُ عُمَرُ بْنُ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ /64 ، فَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : /20 " سَمِّ اللَّهَ وَكُلْ مِمَّا يَلِيكَ "
hadiths.english_translation: Abu Nu'aym Wahb ibn Kaysan said: Food was brought to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and with him was his stepson Umar ibn Abi Salamah, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to him: 'Say Bismillah (In the name of Allah) and eat from what is in front of you.'

hadiths.arabicText: وَحَدَّثَنِي ، عَنْ /12 مَالِك /12 ، عَنْ /94 يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ L8272 /94 ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ /26 الْقَاسِمَ بْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ L1598 /26 ، يَقُولُ : /27 جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ، فَقَالَ لَهُ : إِنَّ لِي يَتِيمًا وَلَهُ إِبِلٌ أَفَأَشْرَبُ مِنْ لَبَنِ إِبِلِهِ ؟ فَقَالَ لَهُ /93 ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ L4883 /93 : /20 " إِنْ كُنْتَ تَبْغِي ضَالَّةَ إِبِلِهِ ، وَتَهْنَأُ جَرْبَاهَا وَتَلُطُّ حَوْضَهَا وَتَسْقِيهَا يَوْمَ وِرْدِهَا ، فَاشْرَبْ غَيْرَ مُضِرٍّ بِنَسْلٍ وَلَا نَاهِكٍ فِي الْحَلْبِ "
hadiths.english_translation: Yahya ibn Sa'id said: I heard al-Qasim ibn Muhammad saying: A man came to Abdullah ibn Abbas and said to him: 'I have an orphan and he has camels. May I drink from the milk of his camels?' Ibn Abbas said to him: 'If you search for his lost camels, treat their mange, plaster their watering place, and water them on their watering day, then drink without harming the offspring and without exhausting (the camels) in milking.'

hadiths.arabicText: وَحَدَّثَنِي ، عَنْ /12 مَالِك /12 ، /27 عَنْ /94 هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ L8055 /94 ، عَنْ /26 أَبِيهِ L5594 /26 أَنَّهُ كَانَ لَا يُؤْتَى أَبَدًا بِطَعَامٍ وَلَا شَرَابٍ حَتَّى الدَّوَاءُ فَيَطْعَمَهُ أَوْ يَشْرَبَهُ ، إِلَّا قَالَ : /20 " الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي هَدَانَا وَأَطْعَمَنَا وَسَقَانَا وَنَعَّمَنَا اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ ، اللَّهُمَّ أَلْفَتْنَا نِعْمَتُكَ بِكُلِّ شَرٍّ فَأَصْبَحْنَا مِنْهَا ، وَأَمْسَيْنَا بِكُلِّ خَيْرٍ فَنَسْأَلُكَ تَمَامَهَا وَشُكْرَهَا ، لَا خَيْرَ إِلَّا خَيْرُكَ ، وَلَا إِلَهَ غَيْرُكَ إِلَهَ الصَّالِحِينَ وَرَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ ، الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ وَلَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ ، اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيمَا رَزَقْتَنَا وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ " /27 . قَالَ /22 يَحْيَى /22 : سُئِلَ /12 مَالِك /12 هَلْ تَأْكُلُ الْمَرْأَةُ مَعَ غَيْرِ ذِي مَحْرَمٍ مِنْهَا أَوْ مَعَ غُلَامِهَا ؟ فَقَالَ /12 مَالِك /12 : /10 لَيْسَ بِذَلِكَ بَأْسٌ ، إِذَا كَانَ ذَلِكَ عَلَى وَجْهِ مَا يُعْرَفُ لِلْمَرْأَةِ أَنْ تَأْكُلَ مَعَهُ مِنَ الرِّجَالِ ، قَالَ : وَقَدْ تَأْكُلُ الْمَرْأَةُ مَعَ زَوْجِهَا ، وَمَعَ غَيْرِهِ مِمَّنْ يُؤَاكِلُهُ ، أَوْ مَعَ أَخِيهَا عَلَى مِثْلِ ذَلِكَ ، وَيُكْرَهُ لِلْمَرْأَةِ أَنْ تَخْلُوَ مَعَ الرَّجُلِ لَيْسَ بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَهَا حُرْمَةٌ
hadiths.english_translation: Hisham ibn Urwah narrated from his father that he would never be brought food or drink, even medicine, to eat or drink, except that he would say: 'Praise be to Allah who guided us, fed us, gave us drink, and blessed us. Allah is the Greatest. O Allah, Your blessings have found us protected from all evil, so we enter the morning by them, and we enter the evening with all good, so we ask You for their completion and gratitude for them. There is no good except Your good, and there is no deity other than You, the God of the righteous and Lord of the worlds. Praise be to Allah, and there is no deity except Allah. Whatever Allah wills (comes to pass), and there is no power except with Allah. O Allah, bless us in what You have provided us and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.' Yahya said: Malik was asked: 'Does a woman eat with a non-mahram or with her servant boy?' Malik said: 'There is no harm in that, if it is in the customary manner known for a woman to eat with men. A woman may eat with her husband and with others whom he dines with, or with her brother in a similar manner. It is disliked for a woman to be alone with a man with whom there is no mahram relationship between them.'

hadiths.arabicText: وَحَدَّثَنِي ، عَنْ /12 مَالِك /12 ، عَنْ /94 يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ L8272 /94 ، /27 أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ أَدْرَكَ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ وَمَعَهُ حِمَالُ لَحْمٍ ، فَقَالَ : " مَا هَذَا ؟ " فَقَالَ : يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ ، قَرِمْنَا إِلَى اللَّحْمِ فَاشْتَرَيْتُ بِدِرْهَمٍ لَحْمًا ، فَقَالَ /93 عُمَرُ L5913 /93 : /20 " أَمَا يُرِيدُ أَحَدُكُمْ أَنْ يَطْوِيَ بَطْنَهُ عَنْ جَارِهِ أَوِ ابْنِ عَمِّهِ ، أَيْنَ تَذْهَبُ عَنْكُمْ هَذِهِ الْآيَةُ : /4 أَذْهَبْتُمْ طَيِّبَاتِكُمْ فِي حَيَاتِكُمُ الدُّنْيَا وَاسْتَمْتَعْتُمْ بِهَا سورة الأحقاف آية 20 /4 ؟ "
hadiths.english_translation: Yahya ibn Sa'id reported that Umar ibn al-Khattab encountered Jabir ibn Abdullah while he had a load of meat with him. He said: 'What is this?' He said: 'O Commander of the Believers, we had a craving for meat, so I bought meat for a dirham.' Umar said: 'Does not one of you want to fold his stomach (abstain) for the sake of his neighbor or his cousin? Where has this verse gone from you: "You exhausted your good things in your worldly life and enjoyed them" (Surah al-Ahqaf: 20)?'

hadiths.arabicText: وَحَدَّثَنِي ، عَنْ /12 مَالِك /12 ، عَنْ /94 عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ L4797 /94 ، /27 عَنْ /93 عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ L4967 /93 ، أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانَ يَلْبَسُ خَاتَمًا مِنْ ذَهَبٍ ، ثُمَّ قَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَنَبَذَهُ ، وَقَالَ : /20 " لَا أَلْبَسُهُ أَبَدًا " ، قَالَ : فَنَبَذَ النَّاسُ بِخَوَاتِيمِهِمْ
hadiths.english_translation: Abdullah ibn Umar narrated that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to wear a ring of gold, then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ stood up and threw it away, and said: 'I will never wear it again.' He said: So the people threw away their rings.
